clips.title: The story
paras: In Thunder Ridge, Fizzle Darkstorm’s claw is carried to Razor Hill as proof of his death. The goblin warlock was a dangerous Burning Blade conspirator.

Orgnil Soulscar sent forces to root out shadow cults threatening the orcish homeland. He identified Fizzle Darkstorm as an instigator spreading corruption in Thunder Ridge. The claw gives Horde commanders proof that the warlock, who operated under the Burning Blade’s banner, has been slain.

Thunder Ridge lies just northwest of Razor Hill, close enough to threaten the surrounding lands. Horde scouts took Fizzle’s claw back to Razor Hill, confirming that his rituals and attempt to establish a Burning Blade foothold had been stopped.
